title: SAP Vigilance Clearance Management System
description: Enterprise SAP ABAP application for managing vigilance clearance requests with approval workflow and reporting.
longDescription: Developed a complete SAP Module Pool application to manage vigilance clearance requests. Features include role-based authorization, request tracking, bulk processing, ALV reports, Smart Forms, and approval workflows using custom database tables and Open SQL.

title: DIYElectro - E-Commerce Platform
description: Full-stack e-commerce platform for electronic components with customer and admin modules.
longDescription: Built a complete e-commerce application featuring authentication, OTP verification, product management, shopping cart, wishlist, order management, customer dashboard, and an admin panel.

title: ShopCraft – Microservices E-Commerce Platform
description: Microservices architecture for an e-commerce platform with independent services and REST communication.
longDescription: Designed an e-commerce backend using a microservices architecture. Implemented independent services for authentication, products, orders, users, and notifications with REST-based communication.

title: Medical Claim Report
description: SAP ABAP reporting solution for employee medical claims with dynamic filtering and ALV output.
longDescription: Developed an interactive ALV report with dynamic search filters, latest-version selection, claim summaries, and optimized Open SQL queries for medical claim processing.

title: Employee Management System
description: Role-based employee management application with authentication and CRUD operations.
longDescription: Developed a web application to manage employee records with authentication, authorization, profile management, and REST APIs for CRUD operations.

title: 3D Printer
description: Custom hardware project focused on monitoring and controlling a 3D printing using embedded systems.
longDescription: A hardware project exploring printer automation, temperature monitoring, serial communication, firmware interaction, and remote print management using Arduino.

title: Attendance-System
description: Attendance management system using Esp32 and RFID with web based GUI for managing records.
longDescription: Developed an attendance management system using ESP32 and RFID with web based GUI for managing records. The system uses ESP32 for RFID reading and web based GUI for managing records.
